title: Titan Foundations
description: Lower-body strength with sumo squats and alternating lunges, finished off with a deep targeted core burn

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide, toes pointing out

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate stepping forward left and right without pausing

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-and-down pulses

exercises.name: Hip thrust (floor)
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift the hips, squeeze the glutes

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
